coordinate_transform: Inverse Web Mercator (WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857) to longitude/latitude, then repository-local approximate campus transform; not a surveyed CRS
story_count_status: estimate; GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 and CountOfFLO=1 are retained as conflicting source values; official front photo and public area information suggest a taller house but do not prove exact floor count
height_status: eave and roof cap heights are estimates; GIS extrusion=36 has undocumented units and is not treated as measured
entry_edge_status: estimated front on the long southwest edge; orientation inferred from the GIS footprint and official front-entry photo, not georeferenced
roof_status: low roof cap is an estimated placeholder; available sources do not resolve roof profile or pitch
interior_status: Only schematic foyer, lounge, dining, and kitchen modules are included, informed by named photo categories in a 2023 chapter feature after 2022 updates. Locations, dimensions, partitions, and current floor plan are not sourced.
